image_description: A dark grey, stocky wombat is captured in a side profile view, foraging in tall green grass. The animal's head is lowered towards the ground, obscuring the nose and mouth area. Its body is robust and barrel-shaped with coarse, thick fur. One forelimb is visible, appearing short and sturdy, while the hindquarters are rounded. The tail is not clearly visible due to the angle and vegetation.

The connection between the visible foreleg and the foot is indistinct; the leg seems to merge into the grass without a clear definition of the wrist or paw structure, typical of AI struggling with paws in vegetation.
